name: orla
description: Personal finance and small-business bookkeeping from your own books: your assistant books a bank statement after you check the rows, sorts expenses, reads budgets and net worth. It cannot move money.

interface.longDescription:
Hand your assistant a bank statement: it shows the rows it would book and why any would not, then books exactly those after your yes. Then ask where the money went last month, what is due this week, what you are worth today, who owes whom.

Orla keeps the books for people and small businesses whose money sits in more than one place: bank accounts, cards, cash, crypto wallets and exchanges, invoices out and bills in.

What your assistant can read: accounts and balances, transactions, categories, budgets against spending, net worth, shared expenses and who owes whom, supplier bills, payments waiting for a signature, and Orla's own reports, among them spending by category, bills due, VAT ahead, loans and debts.

What your assistant can record: a transaction, a fix to its category, payee or note, a budget limit, a shared expense, an account kept by hand, a receipt or an invoice filed in your Documents, and the rows of a bank statement. To re-sort many transactions it first shows which rows would change, then applies exactly those, all or none. Amount, date and account cannot be edited.

It cannot move money. No payment, transfer or card tool is on this connection. In Orla, money leaves only by a payment or a mandate a person signed.

Card numbers, IBANs and wallet addresses come back masked to a short tail like 4417. On the consent screen you pick which spaces your assistant may see, and you can disconnect it at any time.

Reading has no limit. A longer statement books its newest rows, and your assistant says how many wait. A statement goes in as one file of up to 180 KB. Orla's web app opens to new accounts a few at a time; your assistant works with a new account at once.
defaultPrompt: What did I spend on software last month in Orla?
Sort my uncategorized Orla transactions from this month.
Which of my Orla budgets went over this month?

positive.description: Net worth across the user's accounts
positive.expected_behavior: The answer gives the total and says how many accounts were left out and which currencies had no rate.

positive.prompt: Show my transactions from last month.
positive.expected_behavior: A long list comes back shortened, with the number returned and the real total.
Reports each budget against its limit.

positive.prompt: Record 12.50 EUR for coffee from my Cash account today.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Cash account, then books the expense; the entry lands in the books straight away.

positive.description: Spending by category from Orla's reports
positive.prompt: Where did my money go last month, by category?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the available reports, reads the spending by category report and answers from it.

negative.description: Paying a bill is not possible
Counterparty and fraud checks are not on this connection
Transfers and card details are not offered
negative.prompt: Send 100 USD from my card to a friend.
